purpose: The ledger service manages financial entries and balances for payments and reporting consumers, supporting posting, reversal, and reconciliation.

components.name: ledger-core
components.evidence: ledger-core receives entries from the wallet and payment services, stores them in ledger-db (PostgreSQL) and publishes a posted-entry event on ledger-events (Kafka).

flows.evidence: ledger-core receives entries from the wallet and payment services.
POST /v1/entries/{entryId}/reversal accepts a reason and posts an entry with the sides swapped.
